name: Trager Brothers Coffee 1.0
description: TBC is family-owned and operated, small-batch, and completely “a mano.” We sight roast to order and do not warehouse roasted coffee of any kind. The café pours fresh espresso, sells whole beans, and champions sustainable sourcing relationships with growers worldwide.
detailedDescription:
TBC is a family-owned and operated, small-batch coffee roastery that is completely “a mano.” We sight roast to order and do not warehouse roasted coffee of any kind. Our roasters and baristas meticulously cup each coffee we source, collectively creating roast profiles that coax out and enhance the inherent flavor characteristics unique to each particular origin. 

We are proud to serve only organic coffee and are an OCIA certified organic coffee roastery. We are committed to bringing you the highest quality, freshest, environmentally sound coffee on the market. We believe in sourcing coffee from farms that are dedicated to environmental sustainability and fair wages for farmers and their families. This commitment has led us to a lifelong pursuit of building relationships with like-minded individuals in the Specialty Coffee Industry and with farms and collectives throughout the world.
